summary: Veea Inc. (Nasdaq: VEEA) disclosed via an Item 8.01 8-K that on September 14, 2026 it signed a non-binding term sheet with NovaGen Group B.V., an Amsterdam-based personalized regenerative medicine and longevity company, for a proposed business combination. The combined entity would launch NovaGen Health Networks, integrating Veea's HealthLynx edge-cloud platform with NovaGen's cellular reprogramming science; no price per share, ownership split, or premium was disclosed. Definitive agreement execution is targeted within weeks, subject to due diligence (including IP and valuation), shareholder and regulatory approvals. The term sheet is expressly non-binding; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch diligence progress and any equity consideration or financing terms.
